pets.family: Pets and Flowers large-minus-small C-U accuracy interactions, separately for each evaluation panel.
pets.main_panel: test; development is a training/generalization comparison
pets.weighting: Original equal-task/equal-class-side weights; fixed seed mean, image-cluster resampling.
pets.interval_scope: Primary large-small interaction adjusted across two datasets; secondary intervals are ordinary 95%.
pets.positive_direction: Larger C-U favors conditioning for accuracy/gaps; smaller C-U favors conditioning for CE.
